content.text: Root cause found: in `FleetReturnHandler.Codeunit.al`, the `Vehicle` record is fetched before `RegisterDamage` runs, then blindly `Modify`'d afterward with its stale (pre-damage) `Blocked`/`"Open Damages"` values — overwriting what the block subscriber just wrote. Let me view the file and fix it.
The simplest fix: re-`Get()` the Vehicle record after `RegisterDamage` runs, so the mileage/checked-out update is applied on top of the fresh (blocked, damage-counted) state instead of clobbering it.
